title: the tester seals a host-seam's verify on this box
intention: cairn test --host-seam <intention> --seal runs a host-seam intention's verify.command and seals one VALIDATION for this box through the store's door, and standing() reads a host-seam as proven only from this box's own green record whose host facts and intention still match.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 by the orchestrator on b1f182b6b818 and 496dcbeba174: clearance refuses every host-seam crossing with "the crossing names no proof at all", because nothing turns a verify into a sealed validation. installer.run_verify runs the command and leaves no record; node_classes/host-seam.json's prove_gate reads "the tester (IOU: hand-run until built)".
how: D1 validation_store: host_name(), host_facts(), validations_path_for_host_seam(), a host_seam_path door kwarg, and a host-seam branch in standing(). D2 tester cli: --host-seam PATH runs the verify and, with --seal, persists. D3 validation_store charter records that a host-seam seal is box-local. D4 one red-first proof over a scratch fixture intention.

clauses.claim: cairn test --host-seam <fixture verify true> --seal exits 0, lands validations/<stem>/<host>.json green carrying hostname, os id, os version and kernel, and standing(fixture) is proven; the same run without --seal lands nothing
a fixture with verify false exits 1, lands a red record, and standing is not proven
after a green seal, a changed host fact reads not proven and the why names the fact that moved
a green record under another hostname, with none for this box, reads not proven here
after a green seal, an edit to the intention reads not proven

decisions.text: D1: validation_store adds host_name() (socket.gethostname() short, lowercased), host_facts() (hostname, os_id, os_version_id from /etc/os-release or 'windows'/platform.version(), kernel platform.release()), validations_path_for_host_seam(path, host) -> <dir>/validations/<stem>/<host>.json, a host_seam_path kwarg on persist_validation (exactly one of the three), and standing() branching on node_class host-seam to read only this box's file, compare host_facts and the intention's artifact_fingerprint.

D2: tester cli --host-seam PATH runs [bash_exe(), -c, verify.command] with timeout 30 as installer.run_verify does, prints green/red, and with --seal persists claim=verify.green, method=verify.command, horizon=verify.horizon, caller tester; exit 0 green, 1 red, 2 not a host-seam.
D3: the validation_store charter records that a PROVED crossing for a host-seam means proven on the crossing box, and every other box reads not proven until it seals its own.
D4: one proof drives cli.main over scratch fixture intentions, one tooth per clause; host facts are faked by wrapping validation_store.host_facts and restoring it.

out: every code-seal record's shape and address (Q#90)

measured.saw: clearance refuses a host-seam crossing: the crossing names no proof at all; installer.run_verify writes no record
measured.how: the orchestrator's crossings of b1f182b6b818 and 496dcbeba174 on Linux; reading installer.py:49-65
